The '''Lowland Basin''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], consisting of a wide expanse of flat terrain. The homesteads of the [[Lars family/Legends|Lars]] and [[Darklighter family/Legends|Darklighter]] families were located in the region.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lowland Basin was one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
